Create Procedure Dbo.POL_EthicMark_GetReviewData
    @ClassID varchar(50),
    @YearID int,
    @Semester int
As
Begin
    Set Nocount On;

    Declare @PollID int;

    -- Lay PollID
    Select @PollID = Pollid
    From Pol_plan
    Where Yearid = @YearID And Semester = @Semester;

    If @PollID Is Null
    Begin
        -- Tra ve DataTable rong
        Select Top 0
            Cast(0 As int) As Studentid,
            Cast(N'' As nvarchar(50)) As StudentCode,
            Cast(0 As int) As Mark1,
            Cast(0 As int) As Mark2,
            Cast(0 As int) As Mark3,
            Cast(0 As int) As Mark4,
            Cast(0 As int) As Mark5,
            Cast(0 As int) As Mark6;
        Return;
    End

    -- Tra ve moi sinh vien 1 dong, gom diem N1->N6 tu Pol_done + Pol_donedetail
    Select
        s.Studentid,
        s.StudentCode,
        IsNull(Sum(Case When q.Description Like N'%N1%' Then pdd.Reviewmark Else 0 End), 0) As Mark1,
        IsNull(Sum(Case When q.Description Like N'%N2%' Then pdd.Reviewmark Else 0 End), 0) As Mark2,
        IsNull(Sum(Case When q.Description Like N'%N3%' Then pdd.Reviewmark Else 0 End), 0) As Mark3,
        IsNull(Sum(Case When q.Description Like N'%N4%' Then pdd.Reviewmark Else 0 End), 0) As Mark4,
        IsNull(Sum(Case When q.Description Like N'%N5%' Then pdd.Reviewmark Else 0 End), 0) As Mark5,
        IsNull(Sum(Case When q.Description Like N'%N6%' Then pdd.Reviewmark Else 0 End), 0) As Mark6
    From Sim_student s
    Left Join Pol_done pd On s.Studentid = pd.Studentid
    Left Join Pol_donedetail pdd On pd.Doneid = pdd.Doneid And pdd.Reviewmark Is Not Null
    Left Join Pol_question q On pdd.Questionid = q.Questionid
        And q.Pollpartid In (
            Select Pollpartid From Pol_pollpart Where pollid = @PollID
        )
    Where s.Isdeleted = 0 And s.Classid = @ClassID
    Group By s.Studentid, s.StudentCode;

    Set Nocount Off;
End

ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[SIM_SemesterEthicMark_InsertOrUpdate]
    @StudentCode NVARCHAR(50),
    @YearID INT,
    @Semester INT,
    @Mark1 DECIMAL(10, 2) = NULL,
    @Mark2 DECIMAL(10, 2) = NULL,
    @Mark3 DECIMAL(10, 2) = NULL,
    @Mark4 DECIMAL(10, 2) = NULL,
    @Mark5 DECIMAL(10, 2) = NULL,
    @Mark6 DECIMAL(10, 2) = NULL,
    @UpdatedUser NVARCHAR(20) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @Now DATETIME = GETDATE();
    DECLARE @SID INT;
    DECLARE @Mark DECIMAL(10, 2);
    DECLARE @Level NVARCHAR(50);
    DECLARE @CreateUser NVARCHAR(20);
    DECLARE @UpdateUser NVARCHAR(20);

    -- Xac dinh StudentID
    Select Top 1
        @SID = StudentID
    From
        SIM_Student
    Where
        StudentCode = @StudentCode;

    IF @SID IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'Khong xac dinh duoc StudentID tu StudentCode.', 16, 1);
        RETURN;
    END

    -- Tinh Mark = (Mark1 + Mark2 + Mark3 + Mark4 + Mark5 + Mark6) / 5
	-- Neu null thi tinh la 0
	Set @Mark = 
	IsNull(@Mark1, 0)
	+ IsNull(@Mark2, 0)
	+ IsNull(@Mark3, 0)
	+ IsNull(@Mark4, 0)
	+ IsNull(@Mark5, 0)
	+ IsNull(@Mark6, 0)
	;

	    -- Xep loai Level theo Mark
	    IF @Mark >= 90
	Set @Level = N'Xuat sac';
	Else
	If @Mark >= 80
	Set @Level = N'Tot';
	Else
	If @Mark >= 70
	Set @Level = N'Kha';
	Else
	If @Mark >= 50
	Set @Level = N'Trung binh';
	Else
	Set @Level = N'Yeu';

	-- CreateUser / UpdateUser
	Set @Createuser = Left(Ltrim(Rtrim(IsNull(@Studentcode, N''))), 20);
	    IF (@CreateUser IS NULL OR @CreateUser = N'')
	Set @Createuser = N'student';

	Set @Updateuser = Left(
	IsNull(NullIf(Ltrim(Rtrim(@Updateduser)), N''), IsNull(Suser_Sname(), N'teacher')),
	20
	);
	    IF (@UpdateUser IS NULL OR @UpdateUser = N'')
	Set @Updateuser = N'teacher';

	    -- Kiem tra ton tai
	    IF EXISTS (Select 1 From Sim_semesterethicmark Where Studentid = @Sid
		   And Yearid = @Yearid
		   And Semester = @Semester)
	Begin
	-- Da co -> Update
	Update Sim_semesterethicmark
	   Set Mark1 = @Mark1,
		   Mark2 = @Mark2,
		   Mark3 = @Mark3,
		   Mark4 = @Mark4,
		   Mark5 = @Mark5,
		   Mark6 = @Mark6,
		   Mark = @Mark,
		   Level = @Level,
		   Updateddate = @Now,
		   Updateduser = @Updateuser
	Where Studentid = @Sid
	  And Yearid = @Yearid
	  And Semester = @Semester;
	End
	Else
	Begin
	-- Chua co -> Insert
	Insert Into Dbo.Sim_semesterethicmark (Studentid,
										   Yearid,
										   Semester,
										   Mark1,
										   Mark2,
										   Mark3,
										   Mark4,
										   Mark5,
										   Mark6,
										   Mark,
										   Level,
										   Createddate,
										   Createduser,
										   Updateddate,
										   Updateduser)
	Values (@Sid, @Yearid, @Semester, @Mark1, @Mark2, @Mark3, @Mark4, @Mark5, @Mark6, @Mark, @Level, @Now, @Createuser, @Now, @Updateuser);
	End

	Set Nocount Off;
END
